subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Infinity and the Uncountable
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Infinity and the Uncountable.

hook.text: The infinity symbol—a sideways eight—first appeared in 1655. But the idea of the infinite is ancient.

buildup.text: Hindu cosmology speaks of kalpas—cycles lasting 4.32 billion years. Time is so vast it approaches infinity.

discovery.text: Cantor proved in 1874 that some infinities are bigger than others. The uncountable outnumbers the countable.

twist.text: Infinity isn't a number—it's a concept. You can't reach it. No myth has a god who exists at infinity.

climax.text: Infinity is where math and myth both fail. Neither numbers nor stories can contain it. It exceeds every system.

quiz.question: What did Cantor prove about infinity?
options: Some infinities are bigger than others
